change_summary: Add an experiment-only max_daily_return_20_pct OHLCV field and sweep a risk multiplier for non-ETF/non-Commodity core signals in the same-day top quartile of that field.

mid_weak.state_note: rotation-heavy bull where strategy makes money but lags indexes

old_thin.state_note: mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

field_check.note: This allocation experiment does not depend on these fields.

rule_dependencies: OHLCV Close series through signal day

hypothesis: Core signals whose prior 20 trading days contain a top-quartile single-day return may be crowded / lottery-like continuation paths. A risk haircut should improve EV and tail risk without changing entry filters, ranking, exits, universe, LLM, or news logic.
known_risks: Moderate multiple-testing risk because core OHLCV allocation fields have many accepted predecessors.
The top-quartile definition is production-visible but still needs shared implementation if accepted.
A 0x variant is effectively no-trade alpha and must clear trade-count and concentration guards.

market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull where strategy makes money but lags indexes
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

next_retry_requires: Do not retry adjacent max_daily_return20 cutoffs or scalars on the same frozen windows without forward rows or a distinct daily-return path field.
Consider a richer reversal-vs-continuation path cluster only if it is production-visible and not another threshold sweep.
notes: No JavaScript used. This is alpha_search, not measurement repair.

parameters.field_definition: max close-to-close daily return over last 20 signal-known trading days

production_impact.promotion_required_if_accepted: Move max_daily_return_20_pct feature, top-quartile state, and risk haircut into shared feature_layer/risk_engine/portfolio_engine with tests, then rerun the same three-window protocol.

rejection_reason: Best variant failed Gate 4 because at least one fixed window regressed in expected_value_score.
why_not_other_changes: Skipped LLM soft-ranking due sparse attribution, broad-market due identity drift, event/governance/source scalars due recent repeated drawdown/sample failures, state-surface profile/notional retunes due the strict same-family gate, and broad default cap relief because exp-20260522-012 just failed old_thin.
